entities.name: Ali-Qoli Khan Bakhtiari
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sardar Asad Bakhtiari, also known as Haj Ali-Gholi Khan, Sardar Asaad II was an Iranian revolutionary and a chieftain of the Bakhtiari Haft Lang tribe. The third son of Hossein Gholi Khan Ilkhani, he was one of the primary figures of the Persian Constitutional Revolution.
